Licensing and capital create barriers, while the digital channel creates contestability.
Quarterly NIM and PPOP improved, but problem loans increased.
Exit price 28.405 gives 8.37% on the same dividends; terminal ROE needed for 8% is historically attainable, but needs a sustainable capital and earnings bridge.

A quantitative model and retained evidence provide anchors, while capital and terminal assumptions remain sensitive.
Cash dividends were paid and H1 headroom can cover test distributions under some capital assumptions.
Account-level fractional rounding and actions outside the observed bridge can change economic effect.
Book value and dividends increased; a favorable cost-of-credit assumption can yield positive model value plus dividends.
